subject: Next steps: partner technical intake + owner alignment
messages:
From: Aarti Shah <aarti@cloudforge-gsi.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery — technical intake + next owner meeting

Hi Kimberly (and Marissa),

Thanks again for the quick discovery call earlier — we appreciated the clarity on expected throughput and isolation requirements for the pilot. We captured a few follow-ups on our side and would like to schedule a short technical intake with your infra/serving owner and our integration lead so we can scope the marketplace connector work and the demo environment.

Quick asks from CloudForge:
- 45–60 minute technical deep dive with a Redwood infra/serving engineer (networking, auth, model variant routing).
- Confirmation of required access (temporary API key, demo model pin, region).
- Owner alignment: who from Redwood will be the point for deployment and who owns monitoring/tracing for the pilot.

Available windows (PST):
- Wed 9 Dec: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu 10 Dec: 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00

I copied Marissa since she’ll own the MAP and next-step coordination. Devon (our integration lead) will also join once we lock a time.

Attaching a short agenda stub so we can update before the call.

Best,
Aarti
CloudForge — Partner Solutions
[Attachment: Demo-Agenda-20261209.docx]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aarti Shah <aarti@cloudforge-gsi.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery — technical intake + next owner meeting

Thanks Aarti — great to meet you today.

Forwarding to Sean who will be our serving/runtime owner for the pilot and will take the technical deep dive. Sean, could you confirm which of these slots works and whether you prefer the shorter 45m or the full hour?

From our side, we’ll need:
- Temporary demo API key with restricted scope (we can issue for the duration of the POC).
- Confirmation on whether CloudForge needs access to a dedicated model variant or if streaming responses are sufficient for the demo.

I’m fine with Wed 9 Dec 14:00–15:00 PST as a first choice. If that works for you, Marissa and I will update the agenda and MAP ahead of the meeting.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference
[Sent from Redwood mobile]

Proposed owners for the pilot (suggested):
- Redwood deployment & runtime owner: Sean Gallagher
- Redwood PM / partner ops: Marissa Cole
- CloudForge integration lead: Devon Lee

Agenda (45 min) — draft:
1) 5m — introductions & goals
2) 15m — architecture & networking (Sean + Devon)
3) 15m — auth, model pinning, and fallback policies (Sean + Aarti)
4) 5m — MAP next steps & success criteria (Marissa)

Kimberly / Marissa / Sean — thanks, Wed 9 Dec 14:00 PST works for us. Devon and I will join (we’ll be on VPN from our SFO office). Two quick asks before the call:

1) Can you provide a temporary demo API key scoped to the demo tenant? We prefer a key with read/generate but no billing privileges.
2) Example dataset: we’ll use a small synthetic prompt set — if you have a sample prompt file or token estimate that helps us size the session.

We’ve confirmed internal owner: Devon Lee (integration lead), Aarti and I will attend. Looking forward to the run-through — we’ll also invite our security SME if any auth details look non-standard.

Thanks,
Devon Lee
Integration Lead — CloudForge GSI
